lift_pass_products.name: Upper Engadin Snow-Deal day and multi-day ski ticket
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Upper Engadin day and multi-day tickets cover Corvatsch/Furtschellas, Corviglia/Piz Nair, Diavolezza/Lagalb, Muottas Muragl, Zuoz, Pontresina/Languard, Samedan, La Punt, Maloja and S-chanf; only Corviglia/Piz Nair is currently modeled in Snowcast.

lift_pass_products.name: Alta Badia Ski Pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: The local Alta Badia pass covers the modeled Alta Badia core and Lagazuoi for the six Alta Badia stay destinations. Broader Dolomiti Superski and Sellaronda validity remains regional-network context and is not inferred into this local product.

lift_pass_products.name: Auronzo di Cadore - Monte Agudo Skipass
Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta Skiarea Skipass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Includes Pejo as disconnected external pass coverage; Pejo is not part of the ski-connected Campiglio terrain domain.

lift_pass_products.name: Breuil-Cervinia Valtournenche Ski Pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Adult local pass covers Breuil-Cervinia and Valtournenche; from 3 days, official tariff notes limited use in another Aosta Valley ski area within the purchased period.

lift_pass_products.name: Breuil-Cervinia Valtournenche Zermatt Ski Pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: International product adds Zermatt access to the modeled Italian-side Cervinia/Valtournenche ski area through the shared Matterhorn Ski Paradise terrain domain, subject to timetable, weather, and pass conditions.

lift_pass_products.name: Valle Skipass Cortina
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: The official Cortina Skiworld valley product covers Cortina d'Ampezzo, San Vito di Cadore, Auronzo di Cadore, and Misurina. Shared commercial coverage does not create a ski-connected terrain domain.

lift_pass_products.name: Davos Klosters regional ski pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Regional ticket covers the five Davos Klosters Mountains ski areas modeled here. The separately operated Schatzalp / Strela ski area is excluded.

lift_pass_products.name: Schatzalp / Strela ski pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Separate private ski-area ticket; Davos Klosters Mountains regional passes are not valid at Schatzalp / Strela.

lift_pass_products.name: Jungfrau Ski Region ski pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: The pass also covers the unmodeled Mürren-Schilthorn ski area; the published 2026/27 tariff requires a supplement for the Mürren-Schilthorn ascent.

lift_pass_products.name: Col de Varda - Loita Misurina Skipass
Mont-Blanc Unlimited
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Also covers broader Mont-Blanc Natural Resort ski and visit access beyond the modeled local Chamonix valley ski areas, including Evasion Mont-Blanc, Courmayeur, and Crans-Montana access subject to pass conditions.

lift_pass_products.name: Ötztal Super Ski Pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: From 3 days, Sölden ski passes automatically cover all six Ötztal ski areas; Snowcast currently models only Sölden locally.

lift_pass_products.name: Paradiski Essential Pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Covers the linked Paradiski area, including Les Arcs / Peisey-Vallandry and La Plagne via the Vanoise Express.

lift_pass_products.name: Paradiski Pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Covers the linked Paradiski area, including La Plagne, Les Arcs, and Peisey-Vallandry via the Vanoise Express.

lift_pass_products.name: Silvretta Skipass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Available without an Ischgl/Mathon guest card and valid at 75 lifts in Ischgl/Samnaun plus Galtur, Kappl, and See; Snowcast currently models only Ischgl/Samnaun locally.

lift_pass_products.name: Ski ALPIN CARD
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Valid across Skicircus Saalbach Hinterglemm Leogang Fieberbrunn and Zell am See-Kaprun terrain including Schmittenhöhe, Kitzsteinhorn, and Maiskogel.

lift_pass_products.name: Ski Arlberg Pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Covers the linked Ski Arlberg area including St. Anton, St. Christoph, Stuben, Lech, Oberlech, Zurs, Warth, Schroecken, and related Arlberg sectors; only the St Anton weather unit is modeled locally.

lift_pass_products.name: Hintertux Glacier Day Ticket
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Valid at Hintertux Glacier throughout 2026-10-03 to 2027-05-07; from 2026-12-04 to 2027-04-11 it additionally covers Eggalm, Rastkogel, Finkenberg, Penken and Ahorn. Conditional wider coverage is not asserted as year-round modeled-area coverage.

lift_pass_products.name: Multi-day Ski Pass at Hintertux Glacier
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Local Hintertux Glacier 2-21 day product outside the Zillertaler Superskipass main window; the publisher's obvious 2076 typo is normalized to 2027.

lift_pass_products.name: Skipass Mayrhofen
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: The official 2026/27 tariff scopes the 1- and 1.5-day Skipass Mayrhofen to Ahorn, Penken, Rastkogel and Eggalm, including Finkenberg inside Snowcast's Mayrhofen ski-area owner. Hintertux coverage is not asserted because the same-season web page conflicts with the product tariff; glacier-wide entitlement belongs to the separate Zillertaler Superskipass.

lift_pass_products.name: Zillertaler Superskipass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Valid for all lifts in Zillertal from 2026-12-04 through 2027-04-11; wider unmodeled Zillertal members remain external regional-network context.

lift_pass_products.name: Stubai Skipass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: From 4-day passes onward in the Stubai Skipass winter period, the pass also covers Schlick 2000, Serlesbahnen Mieders, and Elferlifte Neustift.

lift_pass_products.name: Tignes - Val d'Isere ski pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Covers both modeled Tignes and Val d'Isere ski areas through the linked Tignes - Val d'Isere terrain domain.

lift_pass_products.name: Val Gardena/Seiser Alm Ski Pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Also valid across the unmodeled Seiser Alm ski area; its complete stay, access, operations/weather, and terrain graph is deferred.

lift_pass_products.name: 4 Vallées ski pass
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Covers the modeled Verbier sector (Verbier, La Tzoumaz-Savoleyres and Bruson) plus the wider 4 Vallées network of Nendaz, Veysonnaz and Thyon when those links are operating.

lift_pass_products.name: International ski pass Zermatt-Cervinia
lift_pass_products.external_validity_summary: Covers the local Zermatt ski area and optional access to the Italian Breuil-Cervinia/Valtournenche terrain, subject to timetable, weather, and pass conditions.
